description: This file defines a composable UI component named HomeCard for an Android TV application. It provides two variants: a default poster card and a TV channel card, each with detailed layout, styling, semantic accessibility labels, and interaction handling for focus and clicks. The code leverages Jetpack Compose, Coil for image loading, and custom theme definitions.

classes.name: HomeCardVariant
classes.description: Enum class defining presentation variants for the HomeCard component: Default and TvChannel.

methods.name: HomeCard
methods.description: Main composable function to display a card with specified content, size, variant, and badges.

methods.name: DefaultPosterCard
methods.description: Composable for rendering a default poster-style card with image, progress, and title.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Composable dedicated to rendering a TV channel styled card with poster, info, badges, and optional icon.
